column1: # Rows db.ptr.ps.* (line RG, D3c-3b): psiblast -in_pssm of NCBI's pointer forms where its reader reads an empty CRef<> (an OPTIONAL member held by CRef<>, an element of a list of CRef<>s, every such member in a skip: NULL, @n, :Type value) against tests/db_search/paja (-comp_based_stats 0 -evalue 1000, outfmt 7; the query_* rows also outfmt 0): tests/fixtures/pssm/d3b_<case>.asn.gz (d3b_<case>.asn where NCBI's error names the file), hand edits of the rnd PSSM without intermediateData, and d3b_b_<case>.asnb, hand edits of ps9_ber_base.asnb (probe D3c-3b). The rows of a value of another class than the declared one (`:Name`) are NCBI's error of its PSSM read (Unrecognized format for PSSM: incompatible member type, class not found); an element stated as NULL is an empty CRef<> in NCBI's object: a Seq-descr element is psiblast's engine error at its search set-up (exit 3, in every output path: outfmt 0, 6, 7, -num_iterations 2, -subject; -out_pssm, -out_ascii_pssm and -export_search_strategy throw at the element, rows .asn, .pssm, .strat), and the S2 rows (inputs of probes 6 and 7, hand edits of d3a_c13_variation.asn.gz) are NULL elements of lists that NCBI's object manager drops or does not read (ncbi rows: their -out_pssm throws at the element, rows .asn) or reads (losat-rejection rows: an exception with memory addresses or a crash). The other losat-rejection rows are LOSAT's refusals of a value of another class in a skip (what NCBI does with it depends on the types its process has met) and of a NULL Seq-id of the query (NCBI's object manager dereferences it). Freeze them alone with `freeze --program psiblast --only db.ptr.ps.`.

# Rows db.ptr.ps.o11.*, db.ptr.ps.o5.*, db.ptr.ps.o0.* and db.ptr.ps.o20.* (line RG, D3c-3c): an element stated as NULL in psiblast's -outfmt 11 (o11: NCBI's archive stops at the element in its ASN.1 text, XML and binary streams, with its 802.5 post and exception, then the error archive of its messages; the XML rows on tests/fixtures/pssm/d3c_r_*.asn.gz, hand edits of the rnd PSSM without annotations; -export_search_strategy and -out_pssm throw first; a Seq-descr element gives NCBI's engine error in the error archive), in outfmt 5 (o5: the engine error), and the refusals of the query's entry (o0, o20: losat-rejection rows whose stdout is what NCBI writes before its object manager stops: NCBI's own where it exits 255, else the start of the report of db.ptr.ps.descr_elem_null.0, the same prolog, as ncbi-near). Freeze them with `freeze --program psiblast --only db.ptr.ps.o`.
